verdicts.reason: PRD §1 states the product bet (evolve from an effects library into a component workbench; 'Components, Playground e Studio formam o núcleo'), §16 sets a north-star metric on configured components that reach save/fork/export, and DESIGN.md (declared as the PRD §15.6 deliverable) turns that bet into surface rules — 'Preview é o padrão', 'O preview é grande', 'Customize fica embaixo do preview... Proibido criar uma variante lite'. Risk table also ties scope decisions to the bet: 'Component workbench é o núcleo; Community e Board exigem PRDs próprios'.

verdicts.reason: The PRD (v1.0 Proposed, dated 12/08/2026, before the build) records stack constraints (RF-CAT-05 Base UI as initial shadcn variant; RF-CAT-04 pinned snapshot; RNF-COMP-02 Windows/Node 22 + Linux CI; §15.6 'Não será instalada outra camada de skills nesta fase'; §18 autonomous push/PR/deploy blocked). DEPENDENCY-POLICY.md pins exact versions (DialKit 1.4.3, Sandpack 2.20.0, MCP SDK 1.29.0, shadcn/React Bits SHAs) and DESIGN.md fixes the design-system constraints (Geist Sans/Mono, 4px base, OKLCH tokens only, lucide-react). QWEN.md records the team constraint: 'The product owner is a designer, not a software engineer.'
